modules.title: 同一通过版本怎样分成持续交付与持续部署

items.title: 持续交付保留“现在发不发”的决定
items.text: 版本自动构建、测试并进入可发布状态，团队仍可在生产前查看测试环境、业务时机和风险，再点批准。人工批准不表示流程手工化，前面的验证仍可自动完成。

items.title: 持续部署让通过门禁的版本自动到生产
items.text: 当团队明确采用持续部署，版本满足预设检查后会自动发布。它需要可靠的测试、监控和止损手段；没有这些证据时，不能因为叫 CD 就默认自动上线。

modules.title: 容易混淆的地方
modules.text: CD 不是只有一种含义：它可能指 Continuous Delivery，也可能指 Continuous Deployment。两者都接在 CI 之后，但生产前是否需要人工批准不同；只自动测试、没有可发布或发布步骤，不构成 CD。

lessonPractice.title: 流水线在 CI 通过后自动部署测试环境，产品负责人确认页面和数据后才点击“发布生产”。这属于哪种 CD？

options.label: 持续交付，因为生产发布前仍有明确的人工批准
options.feedback: 对。版本已经持续保持可发布，但“发到生产”的决定仍由人作出。

options.label: 持续部署，因为测试环境部署是自动的
options.feedback: 测试环境自动部署不决定名称；关键是生产是否在门禁通过后自动发布。

options.label: 只有 CI，因为流水线跑了测试
options.feedback: 这里已把通过版本送到可发布状态并安排生产发布，范围超过 CI。

en.title: After CI passes, a pipeline automatically deploys testing; a product owner checks the page and data, then clicks “release production.” Which kind of CD is this?

options.label: Continuous delivery, because production still has an explicit human approval
options.feedback: Correct. The version stays continuously releasable, but a person still decides to release it to production.

options.label: Continuous deployment, because testing deployment is automatic
options.feedback: Automatic testing deployment does not decide the name; the key is whether production releases automatically after gates pass.

options.label: Only CI, because the pipeline ran tests
options.feedback: A passing version is being made releasable and released, which goes beyond CI.

lessonAgentPrompt.title: 你可以这样告诉 AI Agent
lessonAgentPrompt.text: 请把 CI 通过的版本自动部署到测试环境。生产环境保持持续交付：只有测试地址和关键检查确认后，才显示一个明确的人工批准步骤；不要默认自动发布生产。

en.title: You can say this to an AI Agent
en.text: Automatically deploy CI-passing versions to the test environment. Keep production as continuous delivery: show an explicit human approval step only after the test URL and key checks are confirmed; do not default to automatic production release.

learning.assumes: You know CI can provide build and test results for a commit.
learning.outcome: You can see which environment a version reaches and tell whether production is human-approved or automatically released.

modules.title: How one passing version branches into delivery and deployment

items.title: Continuous delivery retains the release decision
items.text: Versions build, test, and become releasable automatically; the team can still review testing, timing, and risk before approving production. Human approval does not make earlier verification manual.

items.title: Continuous deployment releases passing gates automatically
items.text: When a team explicitly uses continuous deployment, a version reaches production automatically after predefined checks. It needs reliable testing, monitoring, and stopping mechanisms; the label CD alone never proves automatic release is safe.

modules.title: What it is not
modules.text: CD has two meanings: Continuous Delivery or Continuous Deployment. Both follow CI, but differ on whether production requires human approval. Automatically testing with no releasable or release step is not CD.

distinctions.label: CI
distinctions.text: {c:cd} concerns how versions continuously reach target environments. {c:ci} concerns how changes integrate frequently and receive automated build and test feedback.
